about_the_game:
Unite or Fall.
In Hero’s Unison, you’re summoned as a hero from another world. But unlike the chosen ones you’ve heard of before—you can’t fight alone. The enemies of this world are overwhelming, and your only chance of survival lies in uniting with legendary heroes.

A Party Beyond Yourself

Form a 3-hero party, each with unique personalities, skills, and fighting styles. From swift assassins to powerful knight, every hero changes the way you play. Command them in real-time combat or adapt your tactics depending on the battlefield.

The Soul Link System

Our core mechanic: Soul Link. Bond with a hero and inherit their powers—transforming your abilities, unlocking new combos, and reshaping your strategy mid-battle. Every link feels different, making each fight unique.

Command and Synergy

You’re not just a follower—you’re the commander. Time your orders, unleash powerful skills, and discover synergies between heroes that turn impossible battles into victories.

Key Features

  • 7 unique heroes, each with distinct skills and backstories

  • A 3-hero party system that blends action with strategy

  • The Soul Link mechanic that changes how you fight

  • Pixel art adventure across diverse fantasy landscapes

  • Fast-paced, real-time combat with a focus on teamwork

Will you rise as the hero who unites them all—or fall as the chosen one who couldn’t stand alone?

short_description: Hero’s Unison is a 2D pixel action RPG where you are summoned as a hero to a mysterious new world. Form a 3-hero party, link souls with your allies, and unleash unique powers to stand against the darkness threatening all realms.
